fields.control: MASVS v2.1 control id, must exist in controls.json
fields.stacks: detected stacks the rule runs for; '*' runs always
fields.files: glob on the repo-relative path; supports **/, *, ?, {a,b}
fields.pattern: regex searched over the whole file (multiline); '@secret:<name>' resolves to _common.SECRET_PATTERNS[<name>]
fields.message: what the match means; not emitted by the scanner, used by the report
fields.unresolved_pattern: regex or null; if the matched line hits it, status is 'unresolved' (e.g. a ${...} manifest placeholder)
fields.absent: optional true: fires once per file when 'pattern' is NOT found (kind must be config); the line is the requires_in_file match, else 1 with the snippet '(pattern absent from file)'
fields.requires_in_file: optional regex; files that do not contain it are skipped (for absent rules it also anchors the reported line)
fields.unless_in_file: optional regex; files that contain it are skipped
fields.exclude_files: optional glob; matching files are skipped for this rule
fields.exclude_pattern: optional regex; a match is dropped when its line hits it
fields.exists: optional true: fires once at line 1 for every file whose path matches 'files' (and is not git-ignored), without reading it; 'pattern' is empty, kind is config and the snippet is only the file name
fields.requires: optional {lock, package, max_major}: only report when the nearest lockfile pins package at major <= max_major; a missing lockfile skips the rule and lists it under skipped_rules

The lockfile pins a SQLite plugin. Check whether the app uses SQL itself (grep lib/ for the package import) or it is transitive, e.g. cached_network_image -> flutter_cache_manager -> sqflite. If transitive, the 'raw SQL' finding is about the dependency; see references/code.md for the evidence and fix pattern.

Sentry is initialised with an inline options closure in a file with no beforeSend hook, so events (breadcrumbs, request data, exception text) leave the device unscrubbed. An init that delegates to a configure function (arrow or function reference) is not matched, but the closure may still call a configurator in another file that sets the scrubber; confirm before reporting. Crashlytics has no equivalent hook to key a rule on.

Dio LogInterceptor prints request or response bodies, and the file has no kDebugMode/kReleaseMode guard, so release builds write bodies (tokens, personal data) to the device log. Confirm how the interceptor is added.
AES in ECB mode leaks plaintext patterns.
Sensitive-looking value is stored in AsyncStorage (plaintext). Use Keychain/Keystore-backed storage.
WebView originWhitelist allows every origin.
A token/password/secret-named value is logged without a one-line __DEV__ guard. Block-level guards or console-stripping transforms are not detected.
